items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I had a, I had a very good aggregation there that night from the sense of musicians... Baduk on drums, Billy Braun on mellophone... And I was playing piano.

ctx.x: Didn't you have a malaphone player one time?
Oh, yes, and a very, one of the finest. He played, he played saxophone parts. And many times, he'd switch over. Uh, here's a switch for you. Uh, he'd play piano. Billy Braun.
Oh, that's who I was trying to think.
